items.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Conte Candoli, we were the two babies in the band... Conte and I are always telling people we’ve worked together for six decades... Conte and I are still playing together with Doc’s band.

ctx.x: And Jackie and Roy were on the band?

Oh yes. I would put his popularity at that time on a par with Chick Corea at his zenith, or any other group that you know had a zenith couple of years, you know what I mean by that? He was in a sense a very hot attraction. He was definitely a jazz band but he had that commercial tinge by the two kids singing the doodley, doodadly, beedeley vocals. And we would open like the Chicago State Theater, I mean we would be THE not opening act, we would be the closing act there, which was a very big theater, or any of the…
Absolutely. And he still sounds good, too.
